item.title: SEC taps Joshua White as chief economist as audit watchdog names successor - Econ Job News
item.description: He joins the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission after serving as acting chief economist at the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board.

item.title: Princeton economist Katherine Ho dies at 53 - Econ Job News
item.description: Ho joined the university in 2018 and co-led the Center for Health and Wellbeing at the Princeton School of Public and International Affairs.

item.title: FCC names Jonathan Williams chief economist - Econ Job News
item.description: Jonathan Williams will also lead the agency’s Office of Economics and Analytics

item.description: Justin Benavidez takes over from Seth Meyer and comes to the government department from the House Agriculture Committee.

item.title: UChicago awards named professorships to four economists - Econ Job News
item.description: Four economists within the University of Chicago's economics department and Booth School of Business have received new professorships.

item.description: University of Auckland professor Prasanna Gai has been named as a member of its new financial policy committee.

item.title: Yale health economist Singer dies at 87 - Econ Job News
item.description: Burton Singer was a professor of economics and statistics at Yale University and former associate dean of the Yale School of Public Health.

item.title: Economist Abel gets tenure at Bowdoin - Econ Job News
item.description: Martin Abel is an applied microeconomist whose research centers on development, labor and behavioral economics.
